time_elapsed_before_next_call.meaning: timeElapsed value observed when the next call executes, after the same-block state-changing calls

launchpad_fee_accrued_before_next_call.meaning: launchpad fee accrued but not yet distributed at the time of the next call

next_call_is_swap_occurrence.meaning: the very next call to the contract is a swap function call

fee_computed_on_true_deposits.meaning: new launchpad fee is computed only on true deposits and then added to accrued for distribution

lp_share_value_depleted_over_time.meaning: over time LP share value is depleted as reported
lp_share_value_depleted_over_time.checkpoint: after repeated same-block accrual and swap cycles

assumptions: The same-block state-changing calls and the subsequent swap are permissionless and may be performed by any actor; the report does not assert an authorization condition.
The accrued launchpad fee is virtually subtracted from reserves before the next call, as stated in the precondition.
The reported depletion is a potential consequence of repeated same-block accrual and swap cycles, not an inevitable single-call effect.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a numeric definition of 'true deposits' versus the inflated amountIn, nor a concrete bound for the undistributed fee, so the fee-computation relation is represented only by a grounded Boolean.
The report does not specify whether the swap counting the accrued fee is the immediate next transaction or merely the next call to the contract.
The report does not quantify 'over time' or the magnitude of LP share value depletion; the impact is represented as a potential Boolean outcome.

limitations: The selected impact is potential and is not asserted as certain; the plan formalizes only the report-supported conditional scenario.
The fee-computation relation is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report omits numeric definitions of true deposits and the inflated amountIn.
No actor or authorization qualifier is encoded because the report does not state one for the same-block calls or the swap.
Other impacts are not covered by this plan.
